text: Imagine waking up tomorrow…
And every ocean on Earth has vanished.
Millions of ships lie stranded on the ocean floor.
And the blue planet we know… is gone.
Whales and fish are left dying in the mud.
Gigantic underwater canyons are exposed to the sky.
But the real nightmare is just beginning.
Without the oceans, rainfall patterns change dramatically.
Crops begin to die.
Fresh water becomes scarce.
And billions of people suddenly face a terrifying question…
Where will their next drink come from?
Months pass.
Food supplies collapse.
Salt storms sweep across the exposed seabed.
Cities descend into chaos.
From space, Earth no longer looks like a blue planet.
It looks like a dying world.
The oceans once covered most of our planet.
Now, entire ecosystems are gone.
And humanity must fight to survive.
Because without the oceans…
Earth may no longer be a world we can call home.
